verdict: Leads are up; Google's $527 spend is confirmed producing nothing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 137 leads at $16.08 per lead, all of them from Meta — spend and leads both grew roughly 11% week-over-week while cost per lead held virtually flat. Google Ads spent $527 this period and recorded zero conversions, confirming that budget is not producing leads; conversion tracking is being repaired and offline conversion import is scheduled to go live by September 30 so Google can be held accountable to real results. Google Business Profile activity also went dark this past week after 38 actions in the wider window, and that is being monitored. Meta's short-term signal is strong — the last three days alone produced 28 leads compared to 5 in the three days prior — so momentum is real heading into next period.
